objective: Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

description: Now that you have a medallion and can summon an Abyssal Duke, speak with Bor Wildmane.  He will set you on a task against the Abyssal Council.
Good luck, <name>.  And if you ever need more medallions, return to me.
completion: Good to see you again, <class>! So you had a medallion made? Good -- you'll need that for your next quest...
